author: Seiko
text_post: Confidence In A Can- An Instant Technique Some times, especially starting out in the game, you will be in a situation where your confidence is not where you would like it to be. This is a simple technique that can, at least temporarily, boost your confidence and how you are feeling about yourself.  The Technique         When you are in a social setting, whether it be a club, at school/work or w/e instead of google eyeing all of the women, take a look at all the guys. Notice all the poorly dressed, unattractive AFC's who probably put no effort into increasing there desireability for women. Now, take a look at yourself, realize that you are better dressed and more equipped for interactions with women. You know a lot more and as a result have a lot more to offer to women. You definitly are the most worthy. Why It Works        You are what you think you are.  How To Make It Work Even Better        Actually be better dressed, in better shape, and more well groomed than all those AFCs!

text_post: If you stop to look around in that setting and people really dont offer you any competition, then you will feel more confident in that setting, hell you are the best man in the place and women might just pick up on that! Of course this can work both ways and you could see yourself in a place full of mpua's peacocking themselves heavilly. In which case you may feel less confident and have to up your game. I try to be as observant as possible and display value in my own style of dress and mannerisms, which pretty much comes naturally now, I just do it. Id advise simply keeping your eyes open and being all you can be, that is all you can do.
